item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New and improved troubleshooting guides for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Updated troubleshooting guidance is now available for Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server. The documentation adds expanded diagnostics for high CPU, memory, IOPS, temporary file usage, and autovacuum issues to help identify root causes.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Microsoft previewed PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The plugin is intended to make supported AI coding assistants context-aware for PostgreSQL and able to provide guidance and perform actions on a connected database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Extended Support for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now offers Extended Support to keep workloads on supported PostgreSQL versions while you transition to newer releases. It includes critical security updates, critical bug fixes, and technical support.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: New Powershell module: Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer
item.description:
Azure announced the generally available Az.PostgreSQLFlexibleServer PowerShell module, a renamed module for managing Azure Database for PostgreSQL with PowerShell. It replaces the previous Az.PostgreSql-related module naming with a more streamlined experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates
